Nexus BoardViewer

The boardviewer is capable of the following: it supports layers, dual mode view (2 independent views that allow you to work from both sides simultaneously), full-fledged HiDPI support,
tabs, theme editor, key bindings editor, it's fast, compact, portable, it has familiar and intuitive UI and many more. You have to try it yourself to discover all its possibilities :)

For the time being, the project is under active development, so new features will be coming soon. The boardviewer is free (the latest version is available here in the pinned topic: https://t.me/+p2YoPidSSX9hOWI0).

Currently supported formats:
.ASC, .BDV, .BRD (Toptest/Landrex/Mentor Neutral File/Allegro + layers), .BV, .BVR, .CAD (GenCAD, Fabmaster CAD), .CAE, .CST, .F2B, .FAZ, .FZ, .GR, .PCB (XZZPCB + layers), .TVW (+ layers)


For Allegro board files prior to version 16 (which are quite rare), a converter (dbdoctor) is included to convert older files to a newer format. Because of this, the software size has increased.
The BoardViewer itself is currently only ~2 MB in size and does not require any additional dependencies. Allegro versions 16–23 are supported natively.

Minimal OS: Win 10 x64/Win11
